independence_evidence: Published by GAYLETTER, LLC (copyright line on its Substack), a two-founder New York operation that grew out of a weekly newsletter; no media-group ownership.
qualifies_reason: Independent New York queer culture magazine with issues 21 (Feb 2025), 22 (Oct 2025) and 23 (Aug 2026) on sale in its own shop.
what_it_is: A New York queer culture magazine that grew out of a weekly events newsletter. Each issue pairs celebrity and artist cover stories (recently Sam Smith and Guitarricadelafuente, shot by photographers such as Collier Schorr) with interviews, nightlife, art and fashion photography, usually in two cover editions. It is for readers interested in contemporary gay and queer culture, photography and the New York scene.
